title_en: May God Strike the Kochani Seymens
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional, historical-sounding song, no author known. 'Ги однеле' is ambiguous (who was taken up to the middle of the village); I kept it literal and read it as the seymens being led there.

lines.cyr: Бог да бие кочански сејмени, џанам,
lines.lat: Bog da bie kočanski sejmeni, džanam,
lines.en: May God strike the Kochani seymens, my dear,
who descended on the village of Zrnovci.

lines.cyr: - Ој ле вие, зрновски селани, џанам,
lines.lat: - Oj le vie, zrnovski selani, džanam,
lines.en: - Oh you, villagers of Zrnovci, my dear,
are there no more Zrnovci rebels?
The villagers of Zrnovci gathered, my dear,

lines.cyr: ги однеле горе на сред село.
lines.lat: gi odnele gore na sred selo.
lines.en: they took them up to the middle of the village.

lines.cyr: Ги одвеле горе на сред село, џанам,
lines.lat: Gi odvele gore na sred selo, džanam,
lines.en: They led them up to the middle of the village, my dear,

lines.cyr: на сред село, таму кај чешмата.
lines.lat: na sred selo, tamu kaj češmata.
lines.en: to the middle of the village, there by the fountain.

lines.cyr: Уште зборот не ми го дорекле, џанам,
lines.lat: Ušte zborot ne mi go dorekle, džanam,
lines.en: They had not yet finished speaking, my dear,
Bombs and bullets thundered, my dear,
they drove out the Kochani seymens.
